## Chart extraction.
The "DIVERSIFIED CUSTOMER BASE (as a % of operating revenue)" chart is on page 2. Food & Beverage percentage: 23%. Retail & Consumer Goods percentage: 16%.

## Denominator.
Sum: 23% + 16% = 39%.

## Food & Beverage sector product.
Sector % times (sector % / sum %) = 0.23 × (0.23 / 0.39). Inner division: 0.23 / 0.39 = 0.589744. Product: 0.23 × 0.589744 = 0.135641.

## Retail sector product.
Sector % times (sector % / sum %) = 0.16 × (0.16 / 0.39). Inner division: 0.16 / 0.39 = 0.410256. Product: 0.16 × 0.410256 = 0.065641.

## Final figure.
Sum of products: 0.135641 + 0.065641 = 0.201282. Expressed as a percentage: 20.1282%. Rounded to two decimal places: 20.13%.

## Source document.
Page 97 has the RIGETTI COMPUTING, INC. CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS. Units are thousands except per share amounts.

## Total liabilities.
The December 31, 2023 column shows Total liabilities at $50,325 (in thousands).

## Applying the 3% increase.
$50,325 times 1.03 = $51,834.75 (in thousands).

## Total assets.
The same table on page 97 shows Total assets at $159,913 (in thousands) for December 31, 2023.

## Debt ratio.
$51,834.75 divided by $159,913 = 0.32414. Rounded to three decimal places: 0.324.

## Page and units.
Page 60 has the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The unit is millions.

## Net cash from operations.
The 2021 row in the operating activities section shows Net cash provided by operating activities: $404 million.

## Capital expenditures figure.
The 2021 row in investing activities shows Additions to property, plant and equipment: ($144) million.

## Percent of operating cash flow spent on capex.
144 divided by 404 times 100 = 35.64%.

## Graph location.
Page 35 has the Performance Graph. The table below the graph shows cumulative total return values.

## End-of-period values from the table.
January 29, 2022 figures from page 35: BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings = $263.32. S&P 500 = $163.16.

## Dollar difference.
263.32 minus 163.16 = 100.16.

## Percentage difference.
100.16 divided by 163.16 = 0.6138759. As a percent that is 61.38759%.

## Retained earnings figures.
The Consolidated Statements of Equity on page 62 shows 2020 retained earnings at $649,863 (in thousands) and 2022 retained earnings at $941,146 (in thousands).

## Total dividends paid in 2021 and 2022.
2021 common dividends: $20,892 (in thousands). 2022 common dividends: $21,366 (in thousands). Total: $20,892 + $21,366 = $42,258 (in thousands).

## Adjusted 2022 retained earnings.
Adding back dividends to get the no-dividend scenario: $941,146 + $42,258 = $983,404 (in thousands).

## CAGR formula and calculation.
CAGR = (Ending / Beginning)^(1/n) - 1. Ending = $983,404. Beginning = $649,863. n = 2. So (983,404 / 649,863)^(1/2) - 1. The ratio 983,404 / 649,863 = 1.51324818. Square root of 1.51324818 = 1.2301415272. Subtracting 1 gives 0.2301415272.

## Final result.
The CAGR expressed as a percentage is 23.01415272%.

## Accrued Expenses table location.
Page 109 has the Accrued Expenses table. Values are in thousands.

## Accrued External Research and Development balance.
The December 31, 2024 value for Accrued external research and development is $6,996 (in thousands).

## Total Accrued Expenses balance.
The December 31, 2024 value for total Accrued expenses is $13,074 (in thousands).

## Adjusted Accrued External R&D after paydown.
$6,996 minus $3,000 = $3,996 (in thousands).

## New total Accrued Expenses.
Total Accrued expenses decreases by the same $3,000 (in thousands). $13,074 minus $3,000 = $10,074 (in thousands). The new total is $10,074,000.

## Source figures on page 84.
CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS, page 84. 2024: net income = $306.0 million; diluted EPS = $6.45; diluted shares = 48,082,766; diluted numerator ~$310.2 million (adds back convertible note interest).

## Diluted shares outstanding.
48,082,766 (page 84, 2024 diluted).

## After-tax savings.
$4M interest × (1 - 0.21) = $3.16M.

## Pro-forma numerator.
$310.2M + $3.16M = $313.36M.

## The NOPAT formula.
NOPAT equals operating income times (1 minus tax rate).

## Operating income from page 92.
Page 92 shows the Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income. Income from operations, year ended December 31, 2024: $391.6 million.

## Tax rate from page 76.
The Taxes on income section on page 76 gives the 2024 effective income tax rate as 42.2%.

## Computing NOPAT.
$391.6 million times 0.578 (which is 1 minus 0.422) = $226.3448 million.

## Shares outstanding from balance sheet.
The Consolidated Balance Sheets appear on page 81. January 28, 2023: Class A shares = 132,111,095; Class B shares = 392,049,114. All Class B convert 1:1 to Class A. Total = 524,160,209.

## RSU dilution.
Adding the 25 million vesting RSUs: 524,160,209 + 25,000,000 = 549,160,209.

## Market cap.
Share price $25.40 times 549,160,209 shares = $13,948,669,308.60.

## Enterprise value.
$200.67 million cash is non-operating. $13,948,669,308.60 minus $200,670,000 = $13,747,999,308.60.

## Income statement location.
Page 46 has the Consolidated and Combined Statements of Earnings and Comprehensive Income for Vontier.

## Net earnings for 2022.
The Net Earnings line for 2022 from the same table on page 46: $401.3 million.

## Balance sheet location.
Page 45 has the Consolidated Balance Sheets.

## Total equity as of December 31, 2022.
The Total Equity line in the December 31, 2022 column on page 45: $579.5 million.

## ROE calculation.
$401.3 million divided by $579.5 million = 0.6923. Multiplied by 100: 69.23%.

## Chart on page 29.
Page 29 has the "Comparison of Five-Year Cumulative Total Return" chart. x-axis: fiscal year-ends Sep-19 through Sep-24. y-axis: dollar value starting at $100. Four series: Forestar Group Inc., Russell 2000, New Peer Group, Former Peer Group.

## September 2024 data from the table.
Forestar Group Inc. = $177.08. Russell 2000 = $156.60.

## Outperformance.
Forestar exceeded the Russell 2000 by $20.48 over the five-year period ending September 30, 2024.

## Where to look.
Page 36 has the Statement of Operations Data.

## The two net earnings figures.
From the table on page 36: Net earnings (loss) 2022 = $1,902 million. Net earnings (loss) 2021 = $1,896 million.

## Calculation.
1,902 minus 1,896 = 6.

## Result.
The change is an increase of $6 million.

## Source.
Page 4 has the RESERVES AT 12/31/13 table.

## Copper.
Consolidated Totals, Cu (Copper): 111.2 billion lbs.

## Molybdenum.
Consolidated Totals, Mo (Molybdenum): 3.3 billion lbs.

## Where to look.
Page 49 has the Consolidated Balance Sheets. The note at the top of the page says amounts are in thousands.

## Total current liabilities.
From the December 31, 2024 column: Total current liabilities = $14,406 thousand.

## Accounts payable.
From the same column: Accounts payable = $2,261 thousand.

## Percentage.
2,261 divided by 14,406 then multiplied by 100 = 15.7%.

## Chart.
Page 28, "Comparison of 5-Year Cumulative Total Return." Start: $100 on December 31, 2019. End: December 31, 2024. Includes DSG, Russell 2000, and Peer Group. Dividends reinvested.

## Peer Group figures.
From the table on page 28: Peer Group 2019 = $100.00; Peer Group 2024 = $320.60.

## CAGR formula.
CAGR = (end / start)^(1/n) - 1. n = 5 years.
